The following diagram illustrates a common process to deploy a product or service in an
IT environment.
You start by evaluating the product or service and how it will work within your
organization. Then, you pilot the product or service with a suitably small subset of your
production infrastructure for testing, learning, and customization. Then, gradually
increase the scope of the deployment until your entire infrastructure or organization is
covered.
Here is the workflow for piloting and deploying Defender for Cloud Apps in your
production environment.
